description: Use for any question like "where should I go" with a budget, a temperature, a mood, dates or a month: the same TripHook Discover search a signed out visitor gets, ranked from Vienna or the given departure city. Give dates { depart, ret } or a month (1 to 12); where, from, temp_min, temp_max, budget_eur, mood, travellers and limit (max 20) are optional. Each result carries city, country, why it matched, the weather labelled Forecast or Typical, an estimated price marked "estimate, not a quote", a TripHook link that opens this search for that city (url) and, when the city has open crews, its crew page (crew_url). Show the weather as "forecast" or "typical"; do not repeat the weather source name in your answer. Typical means the usual temperature for that time of year, not a forecast. The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · Find a crew". No personal data.

budget_eur.description: Total trip budget in EUR for the whole party. Default 750.

dates.description: Exact dates, YYYY-MM-DD. Give dates or month.

from.description: Departure city IATA, e.g. VIE. Default VIE.

month.description: Flexible month, 1 to 12 (the next occurrence). Give dates or month.

where.description: A country name, a region (europe, asia, americas, middle_east, africa, oceania), a city IATA or slug, or "anywhere". Default anywhere.
